cmd.help:
Plugin usage
PH_CMD_SUPPORT  | send a message to the support Discord channel
PH_CMD_JOIN     | join the Discord server
PH_CMD_RESTART  | restart the server once all players have left
PH_CMD_HELP     | lists all available commands
PH_CMD_INFO     | prints the plugin description
PH_CMD_STATUS   | prints the current plugin status
cmd.info:
DESCRIPTION
This plugin is used to integrate a RisingWorld server into Discord.
It sends 4 types of messages:
1. Support messages sent with command PH_CMD_SUPPORT
2. Messages from the local chat
3. Server status messages (plugin on/off, player dis-connected, files changed)
4. (If enabled) notifications about killed mounts and non-hostile animals as well as
removing or destroying collectible objects (e.g. workbench)

• If the Discord bot is enabled in settings.properties, an admin can write
support messages from Discord to one or all players.
• A Discord channel can be defined so that messages from Discord can be written
to the in-game local chat.
• If "+screen" or "+s" is written as a chat token, a screenshot is sent to the Discord channel.
• If "+screennogui" or "+sng" is written as a chat token, a screenshot without interface is sent to the Discord channel.
• If "+tp" or "+t" is written as a chat token, your coordinates are sent to chat and Discord.

Additionally, there are a few supporting admin commands.
For more information type PH_CMD_HELP
